decision.observation: After reversing, the car sits on the tarmac at 3 mph in gear R, facing up the lane with a blue puddle ahead and the road bending left beyond it. All six dot shapes read pale; the timer reads 16:42.504.
decision.hypothesis: The car is back on course facing the right way. Plain forward throttle should engage gear 1 and build speed on this lane before the left bend needs any steering.
decision.memory: One reverse again pulled the car out of the trees and onto the road. The heading was preserved, so forward throttle resumes progress.
